svg.text: Randomized, Double-Blind, Phase II: Fulvestrant + Everolimus/Placebo | HR+ Metastatic Breast Cancer | NCT01797120
Tumor Assessment Schedule — Secondary ScheduleTimeline (USDM Section 4.14)
Note: Applies across Induction and Continuation phases. Bone scan/Brain CT/MRI as clinically indicated (fn i).
Fulvestrant 500 mg IM (D1+D15 C1; D1 subsequent cycles)
+ Everolimus 10 mg PO QD × 12 cycles → Continuation
Arm B (Control): Fulvestrant 500 mg IM + Placebo PO QD
* Pre-Study: within ≤4 weeks of randomization (≤7 days if overlapping C1D1)
* C1D1: defined as first day fulvestrant+everolimus/placebo given together
* C1D15: only Cycle 1; second fulvestrant dose (loading dose schedule)
* Subsequent cycles D1: ±72h window; End Induction: within 30d last dose
